findings.evidence: LIVE PROOF: 'PYTHONUTF8=1 python -m company_wiki.source_catalog.cli ensure --entity X --document-kind annual_report --as-of-date 2026-07-18 --mode latest_as_of' -> 'error: unrecognized arguments: --mode latest_as_of' (strict _parser().parse_args, cli.py:671). Control: the same command with 'resolve' is accepted and executes. Root cause: fetch_filing._command_arguments (fetch_filing.py:173-175) forwards '--mode <mode>' on every company-wiki invocation, and FC-802's new line 638-640 routes ALL latest_as_of requests through ensure ('action = ensure if (allow_download or is_latest) else resolve'); the ensure subparser defines no --mode (only resolve cli.py:415 and close-gap cli.py:485 do). So every latest_as_of request raises a FilingFetchError from _run_company_wiki_json_retry and the structured-gap result (FC802-1/2, the core of the FC) never materializes. The 5 new tests mock subprocess.run, so all pass while the production boundary fails — exactly the divergence the honest-implementer protocol exists to catch. Even if the flag were tolerated, the ensure handler reads mode via getattr(args, 'mode', None) -> None (parser lacks the attribute), so SourceRequest.mode would be silently dropped; mode is load-bearing in the coordinator (acquisition.py:313,339 and resolver.py:827,853 branch on request.mode == 'latest_as_of' for the metadata-only gap plan). Dropping the flag in filing-fetch is therefore NOT a valid fix — the company-wiki ensure parser must accept and forward --mode. Note: base 85731b20 had the same latent forwarding for the allow_download+mode combination, but FC-802's action line makes it the primary path of the feature. Also note: close-gap DOES accept --mode, so only the ensure leg is broken.
